metadata.datasource: Measured off HARMAN technology, ILFORD HP5 PLUS technical information, 35 mm, ILFOTEC HC (1+31) 6.5 min at 20 C. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 400; base + fog 0.168. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Ilford's wedge spectrogram read as relative log sensitivity (read as tungsten-weighted it implies a 12-16x red filter factor). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
